question: Did TJX beat or miss its Q4 FY 2025 pre-tax margin guidance? Express result as BPS difference
answer: 80bps beat from low end and 70bps beat from high end

rubric.criteria: 80bps beat from low end and 70bps beat from high end

model_answer:
**TJX beat its Q4 FY2025 pre-tax margin guidance.**

- **Q4 FY2025 actual pre-tax margin:** **11.6%**
- **Guidance:** **10.8%–10.9%**
- **Result vs. high end:** **+70 bps** (11.6% − 10.9%)
- **Result vs. guidance midpoint:** **+75 bps**
- **Result vs. low end:** **+80 bps**

TJX itself described the result as **70 bps above the high end of its plan**.

Sources: [TJX Q4 FY25 results](https://investor.tjx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tjx-companies-inc-reports-q4-and-fy25-results-q4-comp-store), [TJX Q3 FY25 guidance](https://investor.tjx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tjx-companies-inc-reports-q3-fy25-results-comp-store-sales)
judge_reason: States a 70bps beat vs high end and an 80bps beat vs low end, matching both official checks.
